description:
Read one of eno.vn's published documents for agents and developers in full, as markdown. Needs no sign-in.

The documents: "llms" (/llms.txt: what the site is and where everything is), "agents" (/agents.md: when to use this MCP server and the Partner API, rate limits and rules), "auth" (/auth.md: signing in, API keys and OAuth scopes) and "pricing" (/pricing.md, where this site publishes one). To find a passage first, use search_docs; each result carries its `doc_id`. Fails with `not_found` for a document this site does not publish.

Returns `id`, `title`, `url`, `text` and `truncated`.

id.description: Which document to read: "llms", "agents", "auth" or "pricing", or the `doc_id` of a search_docs result

name: get_doc

text.description: The whole document as markdown, or its first 60,000 characters when `truncated` is true

title.description: The document's title, from its first heading

truncated.description: true when the text was cut at 60,000 characters; its url serves it whole

url.description: The document's public URL, to cite or to open

title: Read a documentation page
